data.name: Mekhaal
data.gender_notes: Mekhaal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mekhaal means blessed, pure, and bright. It is derived from the Arabic word 'Makhalah' which means pure and clean. This name is perfect for a baby boy who is expected to bring joy, happiness, and positivity into the world. The name Mekhaal carries the meaning “Blessed, Pure, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mekhaal usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed, pure, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mekhaal is a name that represents purity and blessings. It is believed to bring positive energy and strength to those who bear the name. It is also a reminder of the importance of staying pure and clean, both physically and spiritually.
data.etymology: Mekhaal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed, Pure, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mekhaal total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مكحال
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من مكه، مكان للعباده، والصلاه
in_arabic.long_meaning: مكحال هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه: مكان للعبادة والصلاة، مشتق من كلمة مكه التي تعتبر قبلة المسلمين و مكان للصلاة والعبادة. وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَن يَعْصِ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ الْعِقَابِ' (الأحزاب: 8) وقد ذكر اسم مكه في سورة آل عمران: 'وَأَذِّن فِي النَّاسِ بِالْحَجِّ يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا وَعَلَى كُلِّ ضَامِنٍ يَأْتِينَ مِن كُلِّ فَجٍ عَمِيقٍ' (آل عمران: 97)

in_urdu.name: مکحال
in_urdu.meaning: عبادت کی جگہ، مسجد، نماز کی جگہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مکحال ایک مذکر اسم ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے عبادت کی جگہ، مسجد یا نماز کی جگہ. یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقویم میں اس کا اہم مقام ہے کیونکہ مکہ قبلہ اول المسلمین ہے جہاں نماز ادا کی جاتی ہے۔ یہ نام اکثر ان بچوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو روحانی اور مذہبی اہمیت رکھتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मक़्हाल
in_hindi.meaning: पूजा स्थल, मस्जिद, नमाज़ की जगह
in_hindi.long_meaning: मक़्हाल एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ पूजा स्थल, मस्जिद या नमाज़ की जगह होता है। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और इस्लामी कैलेंडर में इसका महत्वपूर्ण स्थान है क्योंकि मक्का पहला क़िबला है जहां मुसलमान नमाज़ पढ़ते हैं। यह नाम अक्सर उन बच्चों को दिया जाता है जिनमें आध्यात्मिक और धार्मिक महत्व होता है।

in_english.name: Mekhaal
in_english.meaning: place of worship, mosque, prayer place
in_english.long_meaning: Mekhaal is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies a place of worship, mosque, or prayer place. The name is etymologically linked to Makkah, the city considered the spiritual center for Muslims worldwide. Makkah is home to the Kaaba, the first Qibla (direction of prayer) for Muslims. The name Mekhaal carries spiritual significance, reflecting purity, devotion, and a strong connection to Islamic tradition. Historically, names related to sacred places have been popular among Muslims to signify blessings and spiritual aspirations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mekhaal holds a significant cultural impact as it reflects the ideals of purity, cleanliness, and holiness that are deeply embedded in Islamic culture. In Islam, keeping oneself and the surrounding environment clean is an essential part of religious practice, making the name an apt reflection of these values.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Mekhaal signifies being pure both internally and externally, symbolizing a person striving for inner peace and spiritual growth. It is a reminder that just as one must cleanse the physical body through ablution and hygiene, so too must one strive to cleanse the heart and soul through prayer, meditation, and good deeds. In essence, the name encourages one to be a vessel for the divine and to live a life that is pleasing to God.
